answer: Vouching with skin in the game: a new identity becomes eligible only after three established members publicly vouch for it, each staking reputation and a small bond, like a beacon that only lights when several keepers agree. One honest person easily finds three real neighbours, but a sybil farmer must recruit or bribe hundreds of trusted vouchers, and every proven fake slashes the vouchers, so the opal of trust is not free. Like a glacier, reputation moves slowly and cannot be forged overnight: mass fakes exhaust the scarce supply of credible vouchers long before they gain weight.
